Dear Ms. Harrington,

Thank you for your complaint regarding the noise from the construction site on Elm Street. We have spoken to the contractor, and they have agreed not to begin work before 8 am on weekdays or 9 am on Saturdays.

If the problem persists, please contact the city's code enforcement office at 555-0199.

Sincerely,
Office of Councilmember Reyes
